'''Mina Nihrum''' was a female [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] along with her sister [[Petra Nihrum|Petra]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> their area was [[raid on Kessan's Landing|raided]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] seeking to abduct civilians.

==Biography==
As a teenager, Mina and her sister Petra, faced a tragedy when their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] died in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] accident. Other family members stepped in to raise the sisters, and when their uncle found a new opportunity on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the sisters followed the rest of their family to their new home.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Petra and Mina Nihrum}}</ref>

For a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], life was calm until mercenaries targeted [[Alien/Legends|alien]] settlers on Taris, killing many, including their two uncles, grandfather, and several cousins. Left as refugees with nothing, the sisters fled to Ord Mantell, where a friend of Mina offered them a place to stay. Now living in the [[Kessan's Landing]] on Ord Mantell, a tough place with limited job opportunities and support, the sisters learned how to deal with their reality by clinging to each other.<ref name="Codex" />

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> Kessan's Landing was raided by Mandalorians of the Hidden Chain seeking to abduct civilians. Mina's friend [[Rommi]] was killed, and she herself was among those who were captured and prepared to be shipped off-world. Before the captives could be transported, they were rescued by Petra who was in the company of the famous [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Storming the Castle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
If the player chose to save Mina, she will later make a brief cameo in the final cutscene of ''Legacy Reborn'' alongside Petra. If the player did not save Mina, Petra will appear in the cutscene alone.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
